name: go-http
description: Go REST API on the standard library net/http (Go 1.26 routing) with slog logging, graceful shutdown, an item.Store seam for a database, optional Redis cache, httptest tests and a static non-root Docker image.

included: Environment configuration (SERVER_ADDR, CORS_ORIGINS, DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, LOG_LEVEL, LOG_FORMAT)
Example CRUD endpoints behind an item.Store interface (in memory; database seam)
Redis cache via REDIS_URL with in-memory fallback
Dockerfile (golang:1.26-alpine build, static binary on alpine:3.22, non-root, wget /health healthcheck)
Table-driven httptest tests, go test -race (make test / make test-docker)
excluded: Database driver, data layer and migrations (DATABASE_URL is read; implement item.Store, e.g. with pgx)
Pack-level docker-compose.yml (gpp's root compose runs the API, database and Redis)
